run_googletest_catch_exceptions_test: run the googletest catch exceptions test script to verify C++ and SEH exception handling
test_CatchCxxExceptionsTest_fixture_cons: test that C++ exceptions thrown in a test fixture constructor are caught and logged correctly
test_CatchCxxExceptionsTest_SetUpTestSui: test that C++ exceptions thrown in SetUpTestSuite are caught and remaining test lifecycle methods still run
test_CatchCxxExceptionsTest_SetUp: test that C++ exceptions thrown in SetUp are caught and TearDown is still called as expected
test_CatchCxxExceptionsTest_unhandled_ex: test that unhandled C++ exceptions abort the program when catch_exceptions is disabled
